title: Plaid feature band
description: A wide navy panel with 24px corners that brightens to electric blue at the bottom right, holding a three-line 70px white headline and a white rainbow-rimmed pill on the left, over a picture slot that covers the whole panel. On phones the panel is tall and the text sits centred at the bottom.
notes: media slot: a picture covering the panel (an engraved portrait over a network globe in the original)
the panel is the foreground colour in light mode and the card colour in dark mode
